New users can claim a free 24-hour trial until July 31. Here's how it works, which models are included, what's worth knowing before you start generating, and exactly how to connect it.</p><hr class="post-content-line-break"><h2 id="how-unlimited-mcp-works-and-what-models-are-included">How Unlimited MCP Works and What Models Are Included</h2><p>Once activated, the trial unlocks unlimited generation across eleven image models, five audio models, and seven video models, usable both on the web platform and directly inside Claude or ChatGPT through MCP. The generation itself works the same way it always has, you describe what you want, the model produces it, the only difference is that nothing gets deducted from your credit balance for the length of the trial.</p><p>Resolution and duration vary by model. Images generally cap at 2K. Video runs shorter, most clips landing around 7 to 8 seconds, at either 1080p or an unspecified resolution. Audio is the one category with a real gap between surfaces: unlimited audio generation works on the web and through Claude, but not through ChatGPT, only image and video do there. And regardless of what you're creating or which surface you're on, Unlimited runs one generation at a time by design, image, video, or audio, rather than several running in parallel, which is part of how the trial stays free for every model included.</p><p>This is different from the two Unlimited offers that already existed: All Unlimited on paid plans, Plus and above, and the Unlimited Models Marketplace bundle. Those were both web-only and stay that way, on the same terms as before, untouched by this launch. Neither one ever included MCP. What's actually new here is Claude and ChatGPT entering the picture for the first time, that's the real story, not unlimited generation itself, which has been available on the web for a while
